investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (290 files) was observed for user globalcorp@globalcorp.ee, well above the 24-hour baseline of 50. Access targeted a Latvija_Finanses_Directo site through Directo MSGraph, with bulk downloads occurring from Tallinn, Estonia. The combination of high data volume, external destination, and access to financial documents suggests a potential data exfiltration scenario or compromised credentials, not clearly explained by normal business activity. This warrants High Priority (HP) classification and immediate investigation.
